text:
Tessa (SRE): Noticing elevated tail latency and packet loss toward several Dedicated pools in us-east-1 since ~11:00 UTC. Affected customer tenants on Dedicated-XL.

NetBot: [ALERT] Network error rate > 2% between edge-proxy-us-east and dedicated-node-pools (net-probe). Auto-incident INC-2024-045 created.

Carlos (Dedicated Ops): Confirmed. BGP routes to a subset of racks are flapping, causing traffic to intermittently hit backup fabric with ~200-400ms spikes. Some sessions tear down, clients retry -> higher error surface.

Aisha (Infra Eng): Correlating with our fabric telemetry: maintenance BFD session didn't clear after a failed upgrade at 10:42. Looks like a partial partition where route withdraws oscillate.

Maya (CS): We have 3 customer escalations in the queue complaining about degraded SLA and increased 429/504 during peak. They're asking for status and ETA.

Tessa (SRE): Immediate mitigations applied: 1) move impacted customer namespaces off the flapping racks to fallback dedicated pools, 2) mark problematic racks as unschedulable, 3) abort pending fabric upgrade to prevent additional churn. Commands run:
```
# cordon racks
kubectl label nodes rack-17 rack-18 node.kubernetes.io/unschedulable=true
# migrate critical namespaces
infractl transfer-tenant --tenant-id=ten-423 --from=rack-17 --to=dedicated-pool-7 --force
```

Carlos (Dedicated Ops): Migration started, traffic shifts in progress. For tenants with long-lived sessions we also applied graceful drain to avoid connection resets. Estimated 20-35 minutes to finish migrations.

Aisha (Infra Eng): Root cause provisional: failed fabric upgrade left BFD timers in inconsistent state, causing route flaps between spine switches and leafs serving rack-17/18. Follow-ups: revert upgrade, add preflight BFD healthcheck, and add automated rollback if flaps detected.

Maya (CS): Drafted customer notice in incident doc. Sending targeted messages to impacted customers now with ETA and mitigations. Link: https://docs.internal.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2024-045/comms-draft.md

NetBot: Network metrics: packet-loss down from 3.8% -> 0.6% after initial traffic shift. Latency p99 trending down but still elevated for a small subset.

Tessa (SRE): StatusPage update posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2024-045 1: Partial degradation for Dedicated pools in us-east-1. We're migrating affected tenants and remediating fabric BFD state.

Carlos (Dedicated Ops): All migrations complete for critical tenants. Racks still under investigation but marked unschedulable. Will run controlled fabric rollback during low-traffic window.

Aisha (Infra Eng): Mitigation complete  traffic largely normalized; will monitor for 3 hours. Action items: 1) full postmortem (Aisha + Carlos + Tessa), 2) add BFD preflight & rollback in upgrade pipeline, 3) improve alerting for BGP flap/route oscillation detection.

Tessa (SRE): Marking incident mitigated and moving to monitoring window. If anyone sees regression, ping @oncall immediately. :thumbsup:
